summary: The run tool records the verified run that started each independent child (cinatra#3749). Add nullable started_by_run_id and a non-unique partial lookup index over starter, organization and creation time, separate from the orchestrator parent_run_id. Fresh-install bootstrap twin in agentRunStartedBySchemaQueries ships in the same change. No backfill, data rewrite, existing key or constraint change, foreign-key cascade or parent behavior change. Historical rows stay null; deleting a starter does not delete its children or rewrite their recorded starter. Idempotent up with ADD COLUMN/CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS; down drops only the new index/column and discards the new provenance, never child rows.
